subject: # IDs of attacks match the detector's attack_type values.
sqli
object: SQL code was put into a request so the database might run it, for example to read data or skip a login check.

subject: xss
object: JavaScript was put into a request so it might run in other users' browsers, for example to steal their session.

subject: brute_force
object: Many passwords were tried against the login page to guess one that works.

subject: dir_scan
object: A long list of common file and folder names was requested to find hidden or forgotten pages.

subject: network_filtering
object: Refuse requests from addresses that are attacking the site.

subject: account_lockout
object: Slow down or lock logins after a few failed attempts so passwords cannot be guessed quickly.

subject: credential_reset
object: If a guessed password worked, change it and end that account's sessions.

subject: enable_mfa
object: With MFA, a guessed password alone is not enough to log in.

subject: parameterised_queries
object: Send user input to the database as data, never as part of the SQL text.

subject: input_validation
object: Only accept input in the expected format and reject everything else.

subject: output_encoding
object: Escape user data before putting it in HTML so the browser shows it as text instead of running it.

subject: content_security_policy
object: A CSP header tells the browser which scripts are allowed so injected scripts are blocked.

subject: update_software
object: Install security updates so known holes are closed.

subject: least_privilege_db
object: Give the app's database user minimal rights

subject: least_privilege_db
object: If an injection gets through, a database user with few rights limits the damage.

subject: hide_sensitive_files
object: Remove backups, config files and admin pages from the public site, or put them behind a login.

subject: disable_directory_listing
object: Stop the server from showing a list of files when a folder is opened.

subject: # ---------- response actions (one-tap buttons) and CSP slots ----------
block_ip
object: Add the source IP to the nginx deny list (dry run).

subject: rate_limit_login
object: Limit how many login attempts per minute the source IP can make.

subject: reset_password
object: Reset the password of the account that was logged into and end its sessions.

subject: notify_developer
object: Send the evidence and the recommended code fix to the site's developer.
